title: Four builds, three meanings
Equal outputs do not erase provenance
code:
from backfill_lab import fixture_specs, make_spec, values

specs = fixture_specs()
old = specs["baseline"]
new = specs["extended_historical"]
print(values(old) == values(new))
print(old.dataset_id == new.dataset_id)
reordered = make_spec(
    old.source, decisions=tuple(reversed(old.decisions)),
    coverage=tuple(reversed(old.coverage)))
print(old.dataset_id == reordered.dataset_id)

title: Inspect the immutable build contract
code:
from backfill_lab import Dataset, make_spec, materialize

spec = make_spec()
manifest = Dataset(spec, materialize(spec)).manifest
bound = manifest["spec"]
print(bound["definition"]["feature_name"])
print(bound["definition"]["window_minutes"],
      bound["definition"]["mode"])
print(len(bound["source"]), len(bound["decisions"]))
print(sorted(bound["code"]))
print(bool(bound["runtime"]), manifest["record_count"])

title: Restart from verified chunks
code:
from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory
from backfill_lab import make_spec, stage_build, publish_dataset

with TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
    store, spec = Path(folder), make_spec()
    first = stage_build(store, "attempt", spec, stop_after_chunks=1)
    resumed = stage_build(store, "attempt", spec)
    replayed = stage_build(store, "attempt", spec)
    dataset = publish_dataset(store, "attempt", spec)
    print(first.next_index, first.complete)
    print(resumed.next_index, resumed.complete)
    print(replayed == resumed, len(dataset.records))

title: Refuse to resume a different run
code:
from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory
from backfill_lab import ContractError, fixture_specs, stage_build

with TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
    store, specs = Path(folder), fixture_specs()
    stage_build(store, "attempt", specs["baseline"],
                stop_after_chunks=1)
    try:
        stage_build(store, "attempt", specs["extended_historical"])
    except ContractError:
        print("changed source: rejected")
    print(stage_build(store, "attempt", specs["baseline"]).complete)

title: Validate before moving a release pointer
code:
from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory
from backfill_lab import (ContractError, ReleaseRegistry, ReleaseToken,
                          dataset_path, fixture_specs, load_dataset,
                          stage_build, publish_dataset)

with TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
    store, specs, ids = Path(folder), fixture_specs(), []
    for name in ("baseline", "extended_historical"):
        stage_build(store, name, specs[name])
        ids.append(publish_dataset(store, name, specs[name]).dataset_id)
    registry = ReleaseRegistry(store)
    before = registry.promote("historical", ids[0],
                              expected_current=ReleaseToken())
    dataset_path(store, ids[1]).write_bytes(b"broken\n")
    try:
        registry.promote("historical", ids[1], expected_current=before)
    except ContractError:
        print("corruption: rejected")
    print(registry.current("historical") == before)
    original = load_dataset(store, ids[0])
    print([row.value for row in original.records])

title: Release a dataset and pin an experiment
code:
from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory
from backfill_lab import (Experiment, ReleaseRegistry, ReleaseToken,
                          fixture_specs, stage_build, publish_dataset)

with TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
    store, specs, ids = Path(folder), fixture_specs(), []
    for name in ("baseline", "extended_historical"):
        stage_build(store, name, specs[name])
        ids.append(publish_dataset(store, name, specs[name]).dataset_id)
    experiment = Experiment("baseline_trial", ids[0])
    registry = ReleaseRegistry(store)
    first = registry.promote("historical", ids[0],
                             expected_current=ReleaseToken())
    current = registry.promote("historical", ids[1],
                               expected_current=first)
    print(current.generation)
    print([row.value for row in experiment.read(store).records])
    print(experiment.dataset_id == current.dataset_id)

title: Rollback preserves data and advances generation
code:
from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory
from backfill_lab import (ContractError, ReleaseRegistry, ReleaseToken,
                          fixture_specs, stage_build, publish_dataset)

with TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
    store, specs = Path(folder), fixture_specs()
    ids = []
    for name in ("baseline", "extended_historical"):
        stage_build(store, name, specs[name])
        ids.append(publish_dataset(store, name, specs[name]).dataset_id)
    registry = ReleaseRegistry(store)
    one = registry.promote("historical", ids[0],
                           expected_current=ReleaseToken())
    two = registry.promote("historical", ids[1], expected_current=one)
    three = registry.rollback("historical", ids[0], expected_current=two)
    print(one.generation, two.generation, three.generation)
    print(one.dataset_id == three.dataset_id)
    try:
        registry.promote("historical", ids[1], expected_current=one)
    except ContractError:
        print("stale generation: rejected")
